headline: One picture, 3 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 3 different works in 2 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 3 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 2 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.007 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): a412cef44c7c on 2 works, 3ecc3fd7e806 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (3).
All 3 works report the same GPS point (31.0, 75.19).
Each of the 3 works started and ended on a single day. The works are spread over 2 dates: 2026-04-27, 2026-04-28.
